message: はいてなければ見られない

name: Synn
message: 「How's that!」

name: Ria
message: 「Not bad, Synn-kun. But...」

name: Ria
message: 「We're just getting started!」

name: Ria
message: 「Did I get you... maybe?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah... I can still, still keep going!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's the Synn-kun I know. Now that's the spirit!」
This fight isn't a clash of physical strength, but of Spirit Power--in other words, a clash of wills.
Whether you're a boy or a girl doesn't matter; the deciding factor in the match is simply having a stronger consciousness than your opponent and the flexibility to wield it.
Merely fending off her swift movements and barrage of attacks won't change the tide of battle.
Inch by inch, forward. Forward. Ria-senpai darts left and right to throw off my line of sight.
Her skirt flutters in time with her movements. Come to think of it, Paqy did say something stupid earlier.
For a split second, my thoughts froze.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, close!」
Ria-senpai doesn't let that opening slip by.

name: Ria
message: 「Where are you looking!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Where, you ask...」
Aah, her skirt again!

name: Ria
message: 「Haaah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek」
At this rate, Ria-senpai's private parts are going to be completely exposed!? I squeeze my eyes shut on reflex.

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh?」
When I open my eyes, I'm met with Ria-senpai's pouting face.

name: Ria
message: 「Forehead flick!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeeez. You're not concentrating at all」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry about that」

name: Ria
message: 「If you don't take this seriously, you're going to get seriously hurt!」
There's no excuse for this... I should just apologize honestly.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry」
I wonder if Ria-senpai hates me now...
Still, there's no way I can tell her I was distracted by her fluttering skirt.

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph♪ What a pathetic way to lose」
I don't even have a comeback.

name: Ria
message: 「Are you up next, Misa-chan?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, Onee-sama. Please go easy on me\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Take this seriously!」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yes!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Round two is beginning. Now then, Mr. Treasurer and Mr. President, how do you read this match?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It can't be helped, Synn. Ria-senpai is a high-priced flower way out of our reach, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're going to say that, it's \{out-of-reach peak|\s12\s12}, not high price」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You two are completely ignoring me, aren't you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's a refined young lady skilled in both academics and martial arts, well-bred and good-natured」

name: Synn
message: 「An unattainable flower... Even if she's out of reach, as a fellow Student Council President, I don't want to lose」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then... why did you lose like that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If he could say it, he wouldn't be having such a hard time」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is it really that heavy?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In cases like this, people usually carry some kind of trauma」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To think Synn had such a painful past...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, I wouldn't actually know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't just make stuff up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa, look at that, the Vice President just threw in the towel! A surprise forfeit?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeeeez! Everyone is way too unserious!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm sorry, Onee―sama! But... there's a very good reason for this―」
Blushing with her head hung low, her eyes dart nervously toward Ria-senpai's lower abdomen.
The fact that she's struggling with where to look means she lost for the exact same reason I did.

name: Ria
message: 「Why can't you take this seriously...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Because... Onee-sama's movements were just too impressive, and um... your skirt...」

name: Ria
message: 「What about... my skirt?」

name: Misa
message: 「Your skirt kept flipping up, so I couldn't concentrate!」

name: Misa
message: 「Right, Sakura-kun!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah! That's right, totally right! I caught a glimpse, thought 'uh―oh' and shut my eyes, and then―」

name: Misa
message: 「U-Um... Onee-sama?」

name: Ria
message: 「G-Geez! You're all a bunch of perverts!」

name: Misa & Synn
message: 「We're terribly sorry!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here I thought it was something serious, and you went and lost for a stupid reason like that...」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Calm down, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've got way too many worldly distractions!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How about having the Treasurer use her weapon to slice away those worldly distractions? Clean in two!!」
Speaking of the root of all worldly distractions, that would be... Wait, she's gonna hack it off with that sword!?

name: Synn
message: 「Yikes! I get it, I get it! I'll focus and do my best!」
The mere fact that my mind wandered there proves I still have a long way to go as Student Council President.
At this rate, I'll never become the Demon King, either.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka! Give me a good slap to knock some spirit into me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Th-Th-Thanks!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Coming right up!!」
Delivering a double-slap without a moment's hesitation--that's a childhood friend for you, I suppose.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You awake?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm good now! All right. Ria-senpai, please give me just one more chance」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, you've got a good look on your face now」

name: Synn
message: 「Next time, I'm going for the win」
Each to their starting position.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then, begin!」
I dashed out the instant the signal was given.

name: Ria
message: 「Haah... haah... I guess I have to give up, huh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could it be that I won!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoooa, amazing job, Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Victory, I did it! It's my first win!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone's so strong. You really surprised me~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, come on. You fought four matches in a row without a break, Senpai. Lolo-chan just swooped in and took advantage while you were worn out at the end」
As the vanguard, I got completely wiped out, of course.
Senpai really is strong. I'm still nowhere near her level.

name: Misa
message: 「Still, I wonder if this brings me even a little closer to Onee-sama...」

name: Ria
message: 「You've all only just started, after all. You're sure to get stronger and stronger from here」

name: Synn
message: 「I sure hope so」

name: Ria
message: 「The Student Council―the Crusaders―are the handpicked elite of the student body. I'm sure it won't take long」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did you hear that, Synn! She says we've got talent!」

name: Misa
message: 「You talk about being handpicked, Nanaka-san, but you just tagged along with Sakura-kun, didn't you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you talking about?」

name: Misa
message: 「And Lolotte-san was just pawned off on us, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Was I? What a strange accusation」

name: Misa
message: 「As for Sakura-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「*Ba-dump, ba-dump*」

name: Misa
message: 「I believe we must stay focused and not let ourselves be distracted by unnecessary thoughts.」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk.」

name: Ria
message: 「That goes for you too, Misa-chan\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「I shall reflect deeply on my actions...」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't any of you settle for where you are right now, okay? I need you all to become even greater than you are.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll do my best to catch up to you, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's no goo~d. You have to aim to surpass the likes of me, got it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, ma'am!」

name: Ria
message: 「Because if you don't...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah! Good work today, everyone♪」
Ria-senpai broke into a beaming smile and rummaged around in her sleeve, pulling something out.

name: Ria
message: 「Since you worked so hard, have some of my special Genjimaki♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my! It looks just like castella!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It looks delicious~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, your sleight of hand is as impressive as ever.」

name: Ria
message: 「Carrying snacks around is just common sense for a girl\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it is?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you for the food~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, she ate it in one bite.」

name: Misa
message: 「Make sure you actually savor it when you eat.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Senpai, do you happen to have seconds?」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry. That was the last of them.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a shame~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I miss green tea!」
While everyone was engrossed in the Genjimaki, Ria-senpai smoothly leaned in close.

name: Ria
message: 「Also, for you, Synn-kun...」
Saying that, what she pulled out was her usual stamp.

name: Ria
message: 「Keep it a secret from everyone, okay?\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Thank you very much. Are you sure it's okay for just me to get one, though?」

name: Ria
message: 「You were super strong, after all, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't I get completely beaten?」

name: Ria
message: 「That just means I had to get that serious myself」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, if I hadn't sparred with you first, I might not have lost to Lolotte-chan either... just kidding\s04」
Ria-senpai mischievously stuck out her tongue.
Feeling somehow embarrassed, I popped a Genjimaki into my mouth.

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious! Thanks for the food!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're very welcome♪」
